decisions.reason: The reference-class electrometer sits at the core of the firm's dosimetry offer and was publicly featured as a flagship on the home page, so the visible commitment and sunk development investment make withdrawal within a year very unlikely.

The oncology risk management software builds on the established QA offer, fits the announced direction toward integration, automation and prediction, and has its own dedicated web page; any slow uptake can still be attributed to the usual ramp-up period for clinical software, so management will persist with it.
